fix.item: Article text with invalid UTF-8 no longer causes a fatal error when filling empty fields
Non-breaking spaces in the article text are now treated as whitespace
Empty fields are only filled from published articles

change.item: The article is identified from the schema event context instead of the request
Uses the Joomla 6 query builder (createQuery) and PHP 8.3 type declarations

addition.item: Installation is blocked on Joomla older than 6.0 or PHP older than 8.3
Fill empty fields from the article
